# ETDA e-Tax Invoice & e-Receipt schema (vendored)

Official ETDA standard **ขมธอ. 3-2560, version 2.0** (UN/CEFACT CrossIndustryInvoice based), copied unmodified from
<https://gitlab.com/etdath-teda-schema/teda-objects/common/e-tax-invoice-receipt> at commit
`abd815a4ccbcbe479f9e0efbdb697c482961daa5` (2025-09-12; last schema change in its changelog: 2024-08-02).

Kept here only to validate the XML this app generates (`npm run etax:validate`, `src/lib/etax/xml.test.ts`).
Only the tax invoice and debit/credit note schemas are included. Update by re-copying from the source repository.
Contact for the standard: eservice@etda.or.th.
